title: Archive one Client without deleting identity, Projects, or history

requirements.invariant: Archive targets one stable ClientID and hides that Client from future new-project selection without deleting its identity, Projects, Transfers, frozen documents, accounting evidence or other history.

ArchiveClient is a distinct history-preserving lifecycle intent. It cannot cascade archive state to Projects, hard-delete/merge/rename the Client, reassign any Project, rewrite frozen history or impersonate the O-025 correction workflow.

ArchiveClient expresses one business intent through typed Ledger values and exposes no arbitrary field map, collection/path/SQL string, generic CRUD, lifecycle boolean, delete flag, Project/history/accounting mutation or backend SDK type.

The Client archive payload is bound to exactly one OperationID, contract version, AccountID, actor PrincipalID and finite client-created time through the shared operation fingerprint and receipt lifecycle; archive defines no competing queue, retry, result or rejection semantics.

Archive carries exactly one expected-revision precondition for the same Client subject so stale intent cannot silently become last-write-wins; local construction records the precondition but does not decide authoritative conflict, dependency preservation or idempotent-already-applied results.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One narrow backend-neutral Client archive operation accepts the validated command and returns the shared OperationReceipt or a stable failure; local validation never substitutes for trusted membership, Client existence/revision or archive authorization at the later server boundary.

This Phase 1 command boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free evidence while the shipped app remains unchanged and no Client table/handler, RLS, Sync Stream, Auth/provider choice, source transform, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: The already-defined ExpectedClientRevision is reused as the typed UInt64 value deriving the exact expectedRevision precondition for the same stable Client subject.

ClientArchiveDraft owns exact Account, actor, operation-contract, stable Client, expected revision and finite capture time; it contains no Project list/name/history/accounting/delete/merge/restore/reassignment input.

ArchiveClientPayload contains only ClientID. ArchiveClientCommand binds it to the shared OperationEnvelope, derives the exact Client subject and fingerprint, requires exactly its derived expected-revision precondition and revalidates all duplicated evidence on decode.

ClientArchiving is the narrow backend-neutral operation port returning the shared OperationReceipt; command receipt validation requires the exact OperationID and exposes no authoritative archived-row/result claim.

ClientArchiveFailure exposes stable bounded time, binding, precondition, subject, fingerprint, receipt, local-acceptance and malformed-encoding codes while reusing shared typed identifier and operation validators.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 contract creates no clients/projects table, lifecycle/revision/audit column, foreign key, check, index, view, tombstone or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No authoritative ArchiveClient handler, membership/Client lookup, revision lock, archive idempotency storage, dependency/history preservation transaction, audit timestamp, conflict result or server update exists.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API and no grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed Account/actor/Client binding is not authorization. No membership predicate, grant, WITH CHECK policy or cross-tenant database test exists.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local Client row/lifecycle projection, Project-selection filter, optimistic archive overlay, upload connector or synchronized visibility/readiness claim is defined.

items: The complete command is canonical Codable evidence over draft, shared envelope, exact expected-revision precondition, Client subject and fingerprint; decode reconstructs through the same validators and byte-identical structured restart is required.

Changed Account, actor, contract, Client payload, revision subject/value/count, command subject, fingerprint or receipt OperationID fails atomically without rebinding identity or converting archive into a generic toggle/delete/merge/cascade.

A deterministic reference adapter may accept the command into the shared OperationJournal and prove exact replay/receipt semantics; this is not physical durable-store, process/device restart, optimistic archived-row, authoritative history-preservation or offline-authorization evidence.

storageMedia.notApplicable: ArchiveClient owns no attachment reference/bytes/retention behavior and cannot detach or delete Client, Project, Item, Invoice or receipt media.

appMcp.notApplicable: No Client archive UI, project-picker behavior, current app service, MCP tool/schema, transport, contract-catalog entry or app/MCP parity claim is wired.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase Project clientName, target Client/archive field, source export or archive-state migration is decoded or transformed. Later migration must reconcile Client identity/lifecycle and every retained reference.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failures are contract values only; no signal emission, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook action is introduced.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and its tests and does not change or link either application project.

The slice cannot visibly or authoritatively archive/restore/delete/merge a Client, cascade to Projects, rewrite history, authorize membership, choose Auth, alter accounting/media state, define provider/schema/migration behavior, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.
O-025, A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016, physical offline verification, production profiling and O-022 remain outside this command boundary.

verification.expected: A valid synthetic draft produces one typed exact-scope ArchiveClient command with one same-subject expected revision and no Project/history/name/accounting/delete/merge/restore/reassignment/generic-write input.

Representative commands round-trip byte-identically with exact Account/actor/contract/Operation/Client/revision/time/subject/fingerprint evidence and no backend path, provider, credential, dependent-row result or archive-authority claim.
Invalid time and changed Account/actor/contract/Client/revision subject/value/count/command subject/fingerprint/receipt evidence fail atomically through Client-archive stable diagnostic codes.

A deterministic reference port returns the shared queued receipt, exact replay returns the same receipt, same OperationID with changed Client/revision intent is refused by the shared lifecycle, and a failing port returns no success receipt.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming server, authorization, provider, migration or production behavior.

notes: Decision-independent Phase 1 Client archive command only. Canonical target authority requires history-preserving archive rather than hard deletion for a Client with Projects or accounting history. O-025 remains fully open because no Client merge or Project reassignment exists. Restore/unarchive is deliberately absent pending its own exact command authority rather than a generic lifecycle toggle. The slice stops before physical durable storage, authoritative dependency/history preservation, server apply, schema/RLS/Sync/Auth/provider, app/MCP, source migration, hosted resources, production access or cutover.
